notes: Garnet Hill (garnethill.com), SR74. Access: plain HTTP/curl blocked by Akamai edgesuite 'Access Denied'; curl_cffi impersonate=chrome131 got clean 200s throughout (confirms prior-pass note). Enumerated the full site taxonomy from the unprotected sitemap index (SiteMapIndex_v2.xml -> SiteMap_CAT_001_v2.xml..004_v2.xml, ~140 category/feature URLs total, covering ALL departments: bedding-home, clothing, shoes-accessories, plus new-arrivals/, sale-clearance/, 50th-anniversary/, inspiration-hub/, digital-catalog/, flannel/, cashmere/). No URL matching best-seller(s), top-seller(s), popular, trending, or customer-favorites exists anywhere in that enumeration. The one near-miss is 'Top-Rated Home' (categoryId 191602, /bedding-home/features/top-rated-home/) and 'Top-Rated Clothing' (categoryId 191629, /clothing/features/top-rated-clothing/): opened both, page header/breadcrumb literally says 'Top-Rated', not Bestsellers/Best Sellers/Top Sellers; meta description uses the phrase 'customer-favorite' but the page's own concept is review-rating based ('top-rated'), not a sales-popularity/bestseller merchandising concept per SS3's three-part test. Excluded as out of scope (not a Bestsellers-type PLP), not recorded as a row since the Bestsellers brief has no ambiguous-flag mechanic and this is a clean rating-vs-bestseller distinction, not a name-only ambiguity. Tried the site's own search (https://www.garnethill.com/search?q=bestseller) which 404'd (wrong path pattern for this WebSphere Commerce PWA site; UnbxdAPI-backed search is not exposed at that path) - not used as further evidence since the sitemap enumeration is exhaustive and site-authoritative. Conclusion: no genuine Bestsellers-type PLP exists on this site.
